topic: How loan apps make small loans feel harmless, updated for RBI's 2025 Key Fact Statement disclosure rule
central_idea: RBI now forces lending apps to show the real cost of a loan on one page before you borrow, but the app is still designed to get you to tap accept before you read it.
engagement_goal: Saves and shares via a practical pre-loan checklist
